name: Crystsee reiceplen
description: Winter sunlight illuminates Lake Baikal's famous blue ice, revealing fascinating bubbles trapped beneath the frozen surface. Every step across the crystal-clear ice offers a unique perspective of one of Earth's greatest natural wonders.
